title: Beter On Java
description: say welcome to a new mode {Beter Purpule}
body:
![This](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d1220469e48d118d83bff61ef703e2e26e495dc4.png)
****The Mode focuses on additions to the Minecraft world.
The reason most of the additions are purple is simply because it is my favorite color.
The additions include:
Animals: A small but dangerous dinosaur with 30 hearts and a rather painful bite; there is also a quirky duck.
Armor: I introduced a new metal called "Sergint," used to craft armor and tools such as swords and pickaxes that are very strong and durable.
Worlds: I created an entire purple themed world consisting of floating islands; it looks beautiful.
I also added new blocks.
If you enjoyed seeing my project, please leave a nice comment.
That’s all,good luck!
